Definition: from G3730; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy:--violence.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hórmēma means violence. It occurs just once, in Revelation.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hórmēma plainly: violence, and I leave it there.
